title: Compare Host and Recording Executors
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Compare Host and Recording Executors.
learning_objectives: Explain compare host and recording executors using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for compare host and recording executors

concepts_covered: An executor is the component that performs a step; recording can preview while host execution runs a local command.
HostExecutor uses os/exec; RecordingExecutor records calls without running them.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
